title: Products
intro: Everything you can list. Mark a product sold out when it runs out on market day, or pause it when it is not in season.
footNote: Deleting a product moves it to trash and removes it from the catalogue; past orders keep their lines. Photos: 4:3, natural light, on wood or paper.

status.sold_out: Customers now see “Sold out” and can ask to be told when it is back.
status.unavailable: The product is hidden from customers until you set it back.

toast.restoredText: Restored {{name}} to Paused. Set its weekly stock again before putting it back on sale.

dialog.title: Delete {{name}}?
dialog.text: It moves to trash and disappears from the catalogue. You can restore it anytime from the Deleted tab.
dialog.pauseHint: To stop selling it for a while without deleting, choose Paused instead.

restoreDialog.title: Restore {{name}}?
restoreDialog.text: The product will be restored in “Paused” status so you can review its stock and price before putting it back on sale.
restoreDialog.stockHint: Its weekly stock was cleared when it was deleted, so customers cannot order it until you set it again.

emptyDeleted.title: Trash is empty
emptyDeleted.text: There are no deleted products in trash.

adjustDialog.title: Adjust stock for {{day}}
adjustDialog.priceHint: Leave blank to keep the current price. A price here also ends a near-expiry deal on this day.

error.quantity: Enter a whole number of 0 or more.
error.price: Enter a price above $0, or leave it blank.

empty.title: No products yet
empty.text: Add your first product and it appears on your stall page right away.

deals.removedText: {{name}} is back to its usual price for {{day}}.

dealDialog.title: Near-expiry deal · {{name}}
dealDialog.onSale: {{qty}} on sale for that day now
dealDialog.result_one: Good until end of {{until}} · the customer has {{count}} day (shelf life {{shelfLife}} days)
dealDialog.result_other: Good until end of {{until}} · the customer has {{count}} days (shelf life {{shelfLife}} days)

noDays.title: No pickup day open
noDays.text: Customers cannot order this product for any of the next 14 days. Check your weekly stock and pickup slots.

why.packedOn: Enter the harvest or packing date.
why.packedInFuture: The harvest or packing date cannot be after today.
why.fresh: Picked on the pickup day counts as fresh, so it needs no deal.
why.notNearExpiry: More than half of its {{shelfLife}}-day shelf life is left on that day. Deals are only for produce past half its shelf life.
why.expiredBeforePickup: This batch is no longer good on that day, so it cannot be sold for it.
